findings.quote: International wire fees listed in full fee schedule.
findings.problem: deferral-in-cell: the Relay table cell sends the reader elsewhere instead of stating a fact. Same deferral in the Relay section ('international wire fees sit in its full fee schedule').
findings.fix: Fetch Relay's fee schedule and state the fee, or write 'Not published on the pricing page' as the fact.

findings.quote: balance-to-balance transfers between Payoneer accounts are free
findings.problem: Contradicts payoneer.com/pricing and the page's own table: sending from a balance to another Payoneer account is up to $4.00 (same country) or 1% + up to $4.00 (different country), moving between own balances is 0.50%. Only receiving from another customer's balance is free.
findings.fix: Replace with 'receiving from another Payoneer customer's balance is free'.

findings.quote: Wise Business, Airwallex, Mercury and Relay replace Payoneer for receiving and holding funds
findings.problem: Opener contradicts the page: Mercury 'does not provide international local receiving accounts in foreign currencies' and Relay 'lists no multi-currency receiving accounts'. The answer sentence overstates what Mercury and Relay replace.
findings.fix: Say Wise Business and Airwallex cover multi-currency receiving and holding, Mercury and Relay cover US dollar business banking, Deel and Remote cover contractor payments.

findings.quote: Versus Payoneer, Wise Business does not provide working capital advances, built-in Value-Added Tax payments, checkout merchant processing, or integrated Employer of Record services.
findings.problem: wise.com/us/pricing/business footer lists 'Accept card payments' under Wise Business products, so the checkout claim is not supported by Wise's own site.
findings.fix: Delete 'checkout merchant processing' (or verify and cite Wise's card-acceptance terms).

findings.quote: Automated Clearing House (ACH) ... Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) ... Annual Percentage Yield (APY) ... FDIC insurance
findings.problem: Acronyms used before definition (ACH, SWIFT, ATM, FX, APY, PEO and US appear in the table first) and FDIC is never expanded.
findings.fix: Expand each at first use, tables included, and expand Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) once.

findings.quote: Several potential pricing changes would alter these recommendations: ... To choose the right Payoneer alternative, identify your top incoming payment methods, calculate your monthly foreign exchange volume ... Five checks to complete before choosing a provider ... may prefer Payoneer
findings.problem: Recommendation and directive framing. The page lists published fees and must not recommend or tell the reader what to do.
findings.fix: Replace 'recommendations' with 'comparison', turn the check list into neutral decision criteria, and rewrite 'may prefer Payoneer' as 'Payoneer publishes a direct Upwork payout partnership'.

findings.quote: Payoneer charges an annual account fee of $29.95 if your account receives less than $6,000.00
findings.problem: Omits the pricing-page qualifier 'Not charged in the first year for paid annual plans'.
findings.fix: Add the qualifier to the Payoneer table row and FAQ.

findings.quote: Remote Employer of Record starts at $599 per employee per month ... US PEO starting at $99 per month.
findings.problem: remote.com lists $599 'for annual contracts'; the table PEO cell drops 'per employee'.
findings.fix: Add 'for annual contracts' and write '$99 per employee per month'.

findings.problem: The page body is well over 2,000 words but the template renders no table of contents (none of the alternatives pages has one).
findings.fix: Add a template-level table of contents for alternatives pages over 2,000 words, or record an owner exemption.
